name: Adolfo López Mateos
contribution: A centre-left Mexican politician and lawyer who served as President of Mexico from 1958 to 1964.
legacy: Declaring his government to be "far left within the framework of the constitution", this person was the first left-wing politician to hold the presidency since Lázaro Cárdenas.

checks.lead: Adolfo López Mateos (Spanish pronunciation: [aˈðolfo ˈlopes maˈteos] ; 26 May 1909 – 22 September 1969) was a centre-left Mexican politician and lawyer who served as President of Mexico from 1958 to 1964. Previously, he served as Secretary of Labor and Social Welfare from 1952 to 1957 and a Senator from the State of Mexico from 1946 to 1952.
